releaseNotes:
Features
- Ship a working update button and harden the update manager (#4)
- Wire the file manager end to end -- agent channel, client, two-pane UI
- Rc-file-transfer -- safe paths, honest listings, verified transfers
- Monitoring and Terminal screens, backed by real readings and real PTYs
- Real PTY sessions and measured system metrics
- Real connect, disconnect and reconnect; fix certificate instability
- Bind the listener, serve sessions, and open pairing windows in-process
- QUIC pairing over the wire, mDNS discovery, per-connection identity
- Secure pairing, device identity and trusted devices
